quotes.speaker: Tom Allen
quotes.text: Itisa sip to bring that man up. If you don’t take him away I'll disigure him for life; he isthe gamest man I ever met.

fights.notes: Tom Kelley, McCoole's second, raised the white handkerchief in token of defeat. The article says it is probable Allen will get his money this time, but the amount is not given.

notes: Stakes and rules are not stated. Referee was Jack Looney. Allen's quote is taken from the 7th round, with OCR errors kept in the excerpt.
